scope: Forty source-scoped documentary character/entity occurrences absent from both earlier Simulation batches and from the 42 historical selectable actors. Three abstract ATB exercises, not forty newly reconstructed people or complete original kits.

methodGuide.application: Data-defined, deeply immutable profiles; native combat orders; no base-state/inventory/save mutation or cross-work rewards.

limitations: All actor statistics, generic shoot and heat behavior are existing ATB test budgets, not original numerical or weapon resource certification.
Thirty-seven nonattested, civilian, conditional, recorded, remote or AI roles remain closed with no dormant statistics.
A collective in Invasion counts as one collective occurrence, never as a newly named individual or forty physical people.
Brooks requires a prepared Legendary Citadel profile. Hock and Keiji stay consultation-only and carry prepared Legendary Stolen Memory conditions.
Fisher, Greer and Kirkland remain limited to mea-prologue; Jacob Foundation remains fou-5.
No new primary source verification, kit, mission, portrait, sprite, animation, recruitment or campaign consequence is claimed.
No browser, complete project build or full project suite was run by this profile-only task; root integration owns those checks.
